Write short notes to /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/story-ending-data-notes/notes.md (create the directory).

OWNED FILES: storygame/story_package/loader.py (only _validate_ending and anything it alone uses), tests/test_story_ending.py, data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml (append one block only). Edit nothing else.

BACKGROUND: the engine supports an authored story ending (`ending` in the pacing document). The ending text is closing narrative shown once, after the final reveal, and the story does not continue afterwards. The loader currently runs the ending text and marker through the narration player-safety scan (protected knowledge terms, known-term leaks) as if they were early narration. That is wrong for an ending: by design it mentions everything the player has learned, including protected terms such as 'Phase Two'. A real text was rejected with: `ending text is not player-safe: narration mentions protected knowledge 'phase'`.

BUILD:
1. loader.py `_validate_ending`: keep the structural checks (known scene, known fact ids in `when`, no outgoing transition from the ending scene, non-empty text and marker). Remove the player-safety scan of the ending text and marker, and delete any helper that becomes unused. Leave a one-line comment saying the ending is shown only after its `when` facts hold and is authored closing narrative, so protected terms are allowed.
2. tests/test_story_ending.py: change the test that expects an unsafe ending to be refused so it now asserts that an ending whose text contains the protected term 'Phase Two' loads; keep the other loader-refusal tests (unknown scene, unknown fact, outgoing transition, empty text). Add a test that loads the REAL shipped package and asserts package.pacing.ending is not None, ending.scene_id == '3C', ending.marker == 'The story ends here.', ending.when has the single predicate fact_id phase_two_conflict_plan_known equals true, and the text is non-empty and contains 'Phase Two'.
3. data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml: append this block at the end of the file, byte for byte (two-space indent as shown, folded scalar, keep the line breaks exactly as written), with nothing else changed in the file:

ending:
  scene_id: 3C
  when:
    - {fact_id: phase_two_conflict_plan_known, equals: true}
  text: >-
    Kristin and Michelle were safe, but their old lives
    were beyond recovery. The broadcast had exposed the detention
    network. Some facilities released their prisoners; others
    remained under Charles's control. Michelle began publishing
    the full archive, including the plan to provoke conflict among
    the survivors. Kristin joined the teams opening the remaining
    facilities. Together, they brought freed prisoners and resistance
    groups into contact so they could coordinate rescues and warn
    one another of Charles's plans. He was still out there,
    counting on fear to drive people back under his control.
    Kristin and Michelle had begun organizing the people he meant
    to divide. Stopping Phase Two would be their next fight, and they would do it together.
  marker: "The story ends here."

Do not reword, fix or comment on this text. It is approved authored story content.
4. Update any existing test whose expectation legitimately changes because the shipped package now has an ending (for example package-wide invariants, the disclosure matrix, narration corpus or knowledge-timeline files). If a generated file such as .plans/disclosure-matrix.json becomes stale, regenerate it with the repo's own script (scripts/disclosure_matrix.py) only if a test requires it, and say so in notes.

HOW TO RUN: confirm `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside the cwd. Tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_story_ending.py, then the full suite with -n auto. Ruff: -m ruff check --fix . and -m ruff format . with the same python. Reply with the files changed.
